OVERVIEW.TITLE: Kanban
OVERVIEW.SUBTITLE: Visualize and manage work across funnels, stages, and tasks.
OVERVIEW.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Funnels organize your team's work into stages. Create your first one to start tracking tasks and conversations on the board.

BOARD.NO_STAGES_DESCRIPTION: Add stages from settings to start placing tasks on the board.

SETTINGS.TITLE: {name} — Settings
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Configure stages, audience, automations and danger zone.
SETTINGS.STAGES_SUBTITLE: Drag to reorder. Each stage can be active, won, or lost.
SETTINGS.STAGES_EMPTY: No stages yet. Add the first one to start.
SETTINGS.DANGER_SUBTITLE: Deleting a funnel removes all of its stages and tasks. This cannot be undone.
SETTINGS.AUTOMATIONS_SUBTITLE: Coming soon: trigger automated actions — assign atendente, send a message, or tag a conversation — when a task enters or leaves a stage.

FUNNEL.DESCRIPTION: Funnels organize tasks by stages and apply automations to conversations.
FUNNEL.DELETE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: This will permanently remove the funnel, its stages and tasks. Confirm by typing the funnel name:

AUTO_CREATE_TASK_FOR_NEW_CONVERSATION.LABEL: Auto-create task for new conversations
AUTO_CREATE_TASK_FOR_NEW_CONVERSATION.HINT: When a conversation arrives in a linked inbox, create a task in the first stage.

AUTO_ASSIGN_TASK_TO_AGENT.LABEL: Auto-assign task to conversation agent
AUTO_ASSIGN_TASK_TO_AGENT.HINT: Tasks inherit the agent assigned to the linked conversation.

SYNC_TASK_CONVERSATION_ASSIGNEES.LABEL: Keep task and conversation assignees in sync
SYNC_TASK_CONVERSATION_ASSIGNEES.HINT: Assignee changes on either side propagate automatically.

AUTO_RESOLVE_CONVERSATION_ON_TASK_CLOSE.LABEL: Resolve conversation when task moves to won/lost
AUTO_RESOLVE_CONVERSATION_ON_TASK_CLOSE.HINT: Closing a task closes its linked conversations.

AUTO_WIN_TASK_ON_CONVERSATION_RESOLVE.LABEL: Move task to first won stage on conversation resolve
AUTO_WIN_TASK_ON_CONVERSATION_RESOLVE.HINT: Resolving a conversation moves its task to the first won stage.

NOTIFY_ON_TASK_STAGE_CHANGE.LABEL: Post activity on conversation when task changes stage
NOTIFY_ON_TASK_STAGE_CHANGE.HINT: Each stage change appends an activity message to the linked conversations — handy for an audit trail.

TAG_CONVERSATION_WITH_STAGE.LABEL: Tag conversation with current stage
TAG_CONVERSATION_WITH_STAGE.HINT: Applies a "kanban-<stage>" label to the conversation and removes the previous one so only the current stage tag sticks.

STAGE.DESCRIPTION: Stages segment tasks by status. Mark a stage as won or lost to close tasks.
STAGE.DELETE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: All tasks must be moved before deleting. Confirm the stage to remove:

TASK.DESCRIPTION: Tasks track work through your funnel. Assign, label and link to conversations.

FORM.STAGE_EMPTY_HINT: Go to Kanban → funnel settings to add stages before creating tasks.
FORM.CONTACT_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search contact by name, email or phone…

TASK.LINK_DESCRIPTION: Pick a task to attach to this conversation.
TASK.LINK_NO_TASKS: No tasks available in this funnel.
TASK.CONVERSATION_EMPTY: No tasks linked to this conversation yet.
TASK.NO_FUNNELS: Create a funnel first to add tasks.

COLUMN.EMPTY: Drag tasks here or add a new one.
